name: SM-87
author: Roger Klaveness
tagline: A 1987 studio: an MMT-8 style sequencer, an S700/X7000 style sampler and an HR-16 style drum machine
description: SM-87 turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a 1987 studio. An Alesis MMT-8 style sequencer records and plays 100 parts and songs. An Akai S700/X7000 style sampler plays with its filter, release and vibrato as measured on an X7000. An Alesis HR-16 style drum machine has 16 pads and 100 patterns. Samples come over USB from Axs7 as to an X7000, and Axs7 can also build samples and a drum kit into the firmware. The MMT-8's and the HR-16's memory dumps go both ways.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments); the sampler follows Axs7's engine.
